source.title: Keystone metro cost factor (BLS OEWS wages, see README cost method)

factor.note: MSA 32580 McAllen-Edinburg-Mission, TX: labour index L=0.704, materials M=1.0. 5/5 trades (OEWS May 2024 via O*NET Texas local-wages search extracts). Ratios to US: 47-2031 0.682; 47-2111 0.719; 47-2152 0.723; 47-2061 0.670; 49-9021 0.767. L = 0.704; factor = 0.40*0.704 + 0.60*1.00 = 0.88. M=1.00 (default, no public citable reason to adjust).

cost.method: Factor = 0.40*L + 0.60*M, rounded to 2 decimals. L = weighted mean of (metro annual median wage / US national annual median wage) for SOC 47-2031 Carpenters (0.30), 47-2111 Electricians (0.20), 47-2152 Plumbers/Pipefitters/Steamfitters (0.20), 47-2061 Construction Laborers (0.20), 49-9021 HVAC Mechanics/Installers (0.10), from BLS OEWS; weights renormalised over occupations available for the MSA. M = materials index, 1.00 for all Texas metros (no public citable reason to adjust); qualitative materials notes per MSA. Wave 2 (2026-10-11): all five trades retrieved from O*NET Texas local-wages pages (OEWS May 2024) via search extracts (Secondary); HVAC missing for 28660, 47380, 46340, 17780 (weights renormalised there). provisional removed for every MSA with >=4 trades.

plainLanguage: McAllen's posted permit checklist lists the 2018 family of building codes and the 2017 electrical code, and the city has planned an update to the 2024 codes - so confirm the edition before you submit. McAllen adopted a new Unified Development Code in February 2026; most homes are in the R-1 low-density residential zone. City staff give the R-1 rear setback as 10 ft, but your subdivision plat often sets bigger building lines, so the plat controls. The building permit is cheap: $0.16 per square foot with no separate review fee - about $455 for a 2,400 sq ft home with a 440 sq ft garage. Water and sewer taps are through McAllen Public Utility; we could not find those charges. The Valley is hot-humid (Climate Zone 2A, possibly 1A under the newest map); McAllen is not in the coastal windstorm area, but strong roof tie-downs are wise. Expect an engineered slab on clay soils.
